titleEn: AI could transform mathematics, but humans will still need to be in the loop
titleZh: 人工智能可能改变数学，但人类仍不可或缺
method: Machine reference translation with paragraph alignment; not manually certified.

paragraphs.en: OpenAI recently announced that one of its AI models solved one of the hardest problems in modern mathematics: the Navier–Stokes problem. The equations at the heart of this problem describe the movement of fluids like water and, according to the scientific definition, air.
paragraphs.zh: OpenAI最近宣布，其人工智能模型解决了现代数学中最困难的问题之一：Navier-Stokes问题。该问题的核心方程描述了水等流体的运动，根据科学定义，空气。

paragraphs.en: The Navier-Stokes equations are essential to understanding phenomena such as ocean currents, blood circulation, and airflow over airplane wings. Yet, mathematicians have struggled for decades to determine whether coherent solutions to these equations exist.
paragraphs.zh: Navier-Stokes方程对于理解洋流、血液循环和飞机机翼上的气流等现象至关重要。然而，数学家们几十年来一直在努力确定这些方程是否存在连贯的解。

paragraphs.en: It was for this reason that the US-based Clay Mathematics Institute, which is dedicated to disseminating mathematical knowledge, chose the Navier-Stokes problem as one of its seven Millennium Prize Problems.
paragraphs.zh: 正因如此，致力于传播数学知识的美国克莱数学研究所将纳维尔-斯托克斯问题选为其七个千年奖难题之一。

paragraphs.en: These are the most important and challenging unsolved problems in modern mathematics, with a prize of US$1 million (£746,000; €895,000) offered for the first correct solution to each. A problem that resisted generations of mathematicians thus has apparently been solved by artificial intelligence.
paragraphs.zh: 这些都是现代数学中最重要、最具挑战性的未解决问题，每个问题的第一个正确解决方案将获得100万美元的奖金。一个困扰了几代数学家的问题显然已经被人工智能解决了。

paragraphs.en: While these advancements sent shock waves through the mathematical world, they seem to be only the tip of the iceberg: On October 6 2026, OpenAI presented its solutions to more than 300 longstanding unsolved problems across most areas of mathematics with their new internal model.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然这些进步在数学界掀起了冲击波，但它们似乎只是冰山一角：2026年10月6日，OpenAI通过其新的内部模型，为大多数数学领域的300多个长期未解决的问题提供了解决方案。

paragraphs.en: Does this mark the end of mathematics as a human endeavour? Answering this question requires a closer look at mathematical proofs. Broadly speaking, a proof is an argument for a mathematical claim that starts from generally accepted assumptions and proceeds through the different steps of reasoning for the claim.
paragraphs.zh: 这是否标志着数学作为人类努力的终结？回答这个问题需要更仔细地研究数学证明。广义地说，证明是从普遍接受的假设开始，通过不同的推理步骤来证明数学主张的论点。

paragraphs.en: Before mathematicians accept such an argument as a proof, they need to check that each step is correct. Computers can increasingly help with this task, but for major AI-generated results, human mathematical supervision and expertise remains indispensable.
paragraphs.zh: 在数学家接受这样的论证作为证明之前，他们需要检查每一步都是正确的。计算机可以越来越多地帮助完成这项任务，但对于人工智能生成的主要结果，人类的数学监督和专业知识仍然不可或缺。

paragraphs.en: However, a fully verified proof is not the end of the story. Mathematicians do not only want to know that a theorem is true; they also want to understand why it is true and what can be learned from its proof.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，一个充分验证的证明并不是故事的结束，数学家不仅想知道一个定理是真的，他们还想知道为什么它是真的，以及从它的证明中可以学到什么。

paragraphs.en: Professor Terence Tao, from Unversity of California, Los Angeles, is one of the world’s leading mathematicians and a prominent supporter of AI’s use in mathematics. He recently coined the term “proof digestion” for the many ways that mathematicians continue to work with a proof after its correctness has been established.
paragraphs.zh: 来自加州大学洛杉矶分校的陶德仁教授是世界顶尖数学家之一，也是人工智能在数学中应用的重要支持者。他最近创造了“proof digestion”一词，指数学家在证明正确后继续研究的多种方法。

paragraphs.en: They may reorganise the proof around more natural concepts, streamline a complicated argument, connect it to existing mathematics, or extract methods that can be applied elsewhere. Proof digestion itself can be highly fruitful and produce new mathematics.
paragraphs.zh: 他们可以围绕更自然的概念重新组织证明，简化复杂的论点，将其与现有的数学联系起来，或者提取可以应用于其他地方的方法。

paragraphs.en: Even after a proof has been digested, the mathematical work is rarely done. Major mathematical results often become stepping stones towards new open problems. Important variants of the Navier-Stokes problem, for example, cannot be solved by the methods of the recent proof proposed by OpenAI. This is typical of major breakthroughs: their importance often lies not only in answering a long-standing question, but also in introducing novel mathematical concepts and opening up new lines of research.
paragraphs.zh: 即使证明已经被消化，数学工作也很少完成。主要的数学结果往往成为新的开放问题的垫脚石。例如，Navier-Stokes问题的重要变体无法通过OpenAI最近提出的证明方法来解决。这是重大突破的典型情况：它们的重要性往往不仅在于回答一个长期存在的问题，而且还在于引入新的数学概念和开辟新的研究领域。

paragraphs.en: Often, one proof simply is not enough. Mathematicians regularly search for new proofs of results that have already been proven. Take, for example, the Pythagorean Theorem: a² +b² = c². This relates to the three lengths of a right-angled triangle.
paragraphs.zh: 通常，一个证明是不够的，数学家们经常会寻找已经被证明的结果的新证明，例如毕达哥拉斯定理：a² +B² = c²，这与直角三角形的三个长度有关。

paragraphs.en: This result was proved in antiquity, yet a book published in the 1920s collects more than 300 proofs for the Pythagorean Theorem that have been established over the last two millennia. If the only purpose of a proof is to establish that a result is true, all but the earliest of these proofs would be redundant.
paragraphs.zh: 这个结果在古代就被证明了，然而在20世纪20年代出版的一本书中收集了过去两千年来对勾股定理的300多个证明，如果证明的唯一目的是证明一个结果是真的，那么除了最早的证明之外，所有这些证明都是多余的。

paragraphs.en: Instead, the opposite is the case: different proofs may reveal new insights into why the result is true, uncover new connections to concepts from other mathematical areas, or suggest new methods of generalisation. Thus, proofs are not only valued for verifying mathematical results, but also for the explanation and understanding they provide.
paragraphs.zh: 相反，情况正好相反：不同的证明可能会揭示为什么结果为真的新见解，揭示与其他数学领域概念的新联系，或提出新的推广方法。因此，证明不仅在验证数学结果方面有价值，而且在它们提供的解释和理解方面也有价值。

paragraphs.en: What exactly makes a proof explanatory or illuminating is difficult to pin down – and remains an ongoing topic in the philosophy of mathematics. This makes explanation and understanding much less clear goals for AI than simply producing a correct proof.
paragraphs.zh: 究竟是什么让一个证明具有解释性或启发性是很难确定的--这仍然是数学哲学中一个持续的话题。这使得解释和理解人工智能的目标远不如简单地给出一个正确的证明。

paragraphs.en: The recent advancements in AI will likely transform mathematical practice profoundly. But mathematics is not simply the production of correct answers to unsolved problems. Proofs still need to be understood, reorganised, connected to other results and used to generate new questions.
paragraphs.zh: 人工智能的最新进展可能会深刻地改变数学实践。但数学不仅仅是为未解决的问题提供正确答案。证明仍然需要被理解，重组，与其他结果联系起来，并用于产生新的问题。

paragraphs.en: As AI models become ever more effective at producing proofs, these other parts of mathematical research may become increasingly important. In the near future, it may therefore matter less who – or what – can produce a proof, than whether this can be used for mathematical progress.
paragraphs.zh: 随着人工智能模型在产生证明方面变得越来越有效，数学研究的其他部分可能会变得越来越重要。因此，在不久的将来，谁-或什么-可以产生证明的重要性可能会比是否可以用于数学进步更小。
